A tiny max_image_size does not crash conversion even when the image exceeds the limit

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Tiny limit: <img src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==" alt="pixel"></p>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(extract_images: true, max_image_size: 10))
puts result.content.inspect
```
